title: problem_modeling.model_requested (v1)
description: Following NoveltyAuditAgent's audit: ResearchOrchestrator instructs ProblemModelingAgent to proceed with modeling based on the frozen ResearchSpec, LiteratureBrief, and NoveltyAuditReport. Payload is intentionally minimal: all three artifacts are read from the Research Store by ref.

research_spec_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen ResearchSpec object.

literature_brief_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen LiteratureBrief object.

novelty_audit_report_ref.description: Opaque ref into the Research Store resolving to the frozen NoveltyAuditReport object.

human_idea_seed_ref.description: Optional human redirection to incorporate while rebuilding the problem model.
